invariants.text: Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
ExternalServiceResponse.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
If the external service is unavailable, the application must not fail and should continue to operate using existing customer data.
The external service response status must be checked to determine whether additional customer information was successfully retrieved.
When the external service returns an error, the error message must be stored in the ExternalServiceResponse entity and the customer record must remain accessible.
The timestamp in ExternalServiceResponse must reflect the exact time when the external service request was made.
If additional information is successfully retrieved from the external service, it must be associated with the corresponding customer via the customer_id.
The application must ensure that a customer record is not modified or deleted if the external service is unavailable.
The status field in ExternalServiceResponse must indicate whether the request to the external service was successful or failed.
The application must maintain a record of all external service attempts, including failures, for each customer.
